title: El Queso de Tequisquiapan, MEXI STORIES
comment: queso-tequisquiapan (MEXI): quesería artesanal bajo los portales de Tequisquiapan, Querétaro. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.PETRA_OLVERA: Mexican woman from Querétaro, cheesemaker, 72 years old, small, brown skin, white hair in a long braid, small gold earrings, a light-blue checkered apron over a dark-green long-sleeve dress, flat black shoes, her hands empty.
chars.NICANOR_OLVERA: Mexican man from Querétaro, 45 years old, stocky, brown skin, short black hair, a round gentle face, a plain white t-shirt, a white rubber work apron, white rubber boots, his hands empty.
chars.VANESA_UGALDE: Glamorous Mexican woman, 38 years old, light skin, long straight black hair, red lipstick, big sunglasses pushed up on her head, a fuchsia silk blouse, white jeans, gold sandals, holding a smartphone.
chars.FULGENCIO_ARVIZU: Mexican rancher boss from Querétaro, 72 years old, tall, light-brown skin, white hair, a short white beard, a grey felt cowboy hat, a tan suede jacket over a white shirt, a silver belt buckle, dark jeans, brown boots, holding dark sunglasses.

locs.LOC_QUESERIA: Small artisan cheese shop under a stone arcade in Tequisquiapan, Querétaro, in the morning: a wooden counter with rounds of fresh white cheese, metal milk cans, a big steel vat with curd, cheesecloths hanging to dry, a cobblestone square with pink bougainvillea and a parish church tower in the distance, soft morning light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
